title: Child Support Enforcement Act (Luật Thi hành Trợ cấp Trẻ em)

versions.text:
Child Support Enforcement – 42 USC §651 et seq.
Federal-State cooperative system for locating absent parents, establishing paternity, establishing child support obligations, and enforcing those obligations. Federal Parent Locator Service. Income withholding. Interstate enforcement through UIFSA (Uniform Interstate Family Support Act).
